question: Is the price likely to be higher in 5 trading days?
model: Gradient-boosted classifier on momentum inputs, every symbol pooled, refit every month from 2026-07 on the closed days before it
rule: The next 5 days continue the last 10 days' direction
signalRule: The last 5 days' direction, called only when that move is large against its noise; each month's cut-off is the lowest that was right at least 85% of the time on the closed days before it
notice: A machine-learning read on a simulated market. It can be wrong and must not be taken as true, as a prediction of any real market, or as advice to buy or sell.
